تبتلون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَلُونَ (tabtalūna) /tab.ta.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# تُبْتَلَوْنَ (tubtalawna) /tub.ta.law.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
